Name: DMC 'Kids' Nero and Kyrie
Author: VegetaBul
Description:
[left][b]1.1.0 重要更新：[/b]
[list]
[*]增加adopted children文件覆盖命令
[/list][b]1.1.0 Major Update: [/b]
[list]
[*]Added adopted children file override command
[/list]————————————————————[/left][center]
[b]﻿Vergil's Children[/b][/center]
[b]模组内容：
[/b]
[list]
[*]玩家与 Vergil 结婚后，孩子将固定为 Nero（男孩）与 Kyrie（女孩）
[/list][list]
[*]Nero 和 Kyrie 的季节性服装
[/list][list]
[*]你也可以将与其他npc共同养育的孩子改为 Nero 和 Kyrie（详情参考[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]）
[/list][b]安装模组：[/b]

[list=1]
[*]首先确保你已经安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url] 
[/list][list=1]
[*]将文件解压，拖入[i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*]如果你已经有了孩子，可以在[i]Stardew Valley > Mods > Unique Children > children [/i]中改变现有孩子的属性（详情参考[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]）
[/list]

[b][center]﻿Vergil's Children[/center][/b]
[b]Mod Content:
[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod is part of my [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38952]DMC Vergil[/url] [/b]series. Due to personal limitations, the mod does not have an English version yet.
[/list][list]
[*]However, you can still have [b]Nero (boy)[/b] and [b]Kyrie (girl)[/b] as your children with any NPC.
[/list]
[b]How to install:

[/b] ﻿1. Make sure you have [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url][/b] installed.

﻿2. Extract this mod, then replace the corresponding NPC’s [i]png[/i] files in their folder with the [i]png[/i] files found in this mod.
﻿ ﻿e.g. [i]DMC Baby Nero & Kyrie\assets\Natural\Vergil\Toddler\Boy\Body.png [/i]to
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[i]Mods\UniqueChildren\assets\Natural\NPCName\Toddler\Boy\Body.png[/i]

﻿3. If you already have children, you can modify their attributes in: 
[i] ﻿ ﻿Stardew Valley > Mods > Unique Children > children

[/i] ﻿4. Refer to[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url] for detailed instructions.[i]
[/i]
